---
name: Research evidence or proposal
about: Propose scoped research or report a reproducibility gap.
title: "[Research] "
---

## Question and scope

State the question, game, edition, build, mode, season, and relevant class/scenario. Mark unknown values explicitly.

## Sources and method

Link to public sources or existing repository evidence. Describe lawful source prerequisites, tool versions, and reproduction steps. Use logical source references instead of personal paths; do not attach game resources or extracted databases.

## Observations and limits

Separate actual results, failed or skipped checks, assumptions, proposals, and unknowns. Explain what would validate or invalidate the conclusion. Static fields alone do not establish complete mechanics, DPS, or final drop probabilities.

## Proposed repository change

Identify the documentation, reproducibility tool, or selected evidence that would help readers. Keep private captures, real character snapshots, credentials, saves, tools, and decompiled intermediates local.
